page.title: Pin a goal and see the way on campus
page.lead: A phase of a fictitious course, with three buildings. The author suggests goals, each one tied to quests; you pin one or more on the HUD, and the buildings that still hold a quest of the goal get a marker. A goal is met when its quests are completed.
page.sceneLabel: 3D campus of {phase}, with {count} buildings. Marked buildings: {marked}.
page.keysMove: W/S or ↑/↓: walk · A/D or ←/→: turn
page.keysGoals: G: opens the goals · in the list, 1 to 9 and 0 (or Enter) pin and unpin
page.keysInteract: Near a building: E does its quest (in the demo, it completes right away)
page.keysTouch: On touch: the joystick walks and turns; the Goals and Do quest buttons do the rest

hud.noPins: No goal pinned. Press G (or tap Goals) to choose.
hud.phaseDone: Phase complete: every quest is done.
hud.nothingHere: Nothing to do here: this building's quests are done.

panel.title: Phase goals
panel.intro: The author suggested these goals. Choose the ones you want to follow: their buildings get the marker.
panel.label: Phase goals: choose to pin or unpin
panel.noGoalsIntro: This phase has no author goals. The HUD suggests the next open quest, and its building gets the marker.

list.hint: Numbers 1–9 and 0 choose · ←/→ page · ↑/↓ and Enter · Home/End

joystick.label: Joystick: drag to walk and turn
